# Mixkit

> > Mixkit provides royalty-free stock video footage, music, sound effects, and art assets for video production and creative projects.

Mixkit offers a comprehensive library of free creative assets including 4K/HD video footage without watermarks, stock illustrations in PNG format, sound effects, and video templates. All content is licensed for both commercial and non-commercial use, making it a go-to resource for video editors, content creators, and designers.
